tool_args.rationale: The response rises and saturates with u_now, but only u_now varies. The thermal-fin bridge note describes a two-layer siphon and a before/after contrast, so the present data do not identify its contribution or rule out a snapshot mechanism. The targeted open-branch probe is the lowest-cost discriminating measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth saturating or quartic snapshot law to the five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations hold the other inputs and horizon fixed; these values alone do not distinguish a direct snapshot response from the indicated thermal-fin bridge contrast.
More samples along the same response are less informative than a probe designed to discriminate the open branch.
It is unrelated to the observed bridge/flux mechanisms and is not justified.
